title: Hero management presentation extraction
summary: Move the complete Hero overview, army and artifact deck into a dedicated renderer and local state owner. Preserve native actions and shared window navigation; cancel Hero selection and held input on resize.
preparation: Verify the exact candidate receipt, package is.xyz.vcmi.thor and APK checksum; install preserving data. Prepare a disposable save with two owned heroes, several army stacks, equipped artifacts and enough backpack items for multiple pages. Include Hero opened from Town and installed visuals or text fallback.
limitations: No native, JNI, action-ID, gameplay, server, save or primary-input changes. Army split editing, spell casting and native child dialogs retain their existing upper-screen controls. The native owner remains authoritative for legality and pending/completion handling.

checks.title: Overview and complete navigation
checks.steps: Open Hero from Adventure and from Town. Compare name, portrait, status and all overview details. Use lower Previous, Next and Close at both roster boundaries. Switch Hero while Army/Artifacts is selected; open and close native child dialogs.
checks.expected: Existing information, layout and native navigation remain correct. Hero identity changes reset local tab/page/selection; child and parent restoration shows only current state. No extra native request or residual window.

checks.title: Army selection and authoritative actions
checks.steps: Use the lower Army tab: select and deselect a stack, move into an empty slot, merge matching stacks and swap differing stacks. Exercise last-stack restrictions, unavailable/read-only control and rapid repeated input. Compare upper and lower state after completion or rejection.
checks.expected: Existing pair actions run once through the native owner; server legality is unchanged. Current state refresh clears selections, pending actions remain disabled and rejection never reports success or leaves stale controls.

checks.title: Artifacts, paging and visuals
checks.steps: Equip, unequip and swap artifacts using lower source/destination taps, including across backpack pages. Try empty sources, locked slots and restricted destinations. Navigate first/last pages and change Hero. Check installed artwork and generic/text fallback.
checks.expected: Native artifact semantics and layout are preserved. Locked/empty sources and unpublished rows cannot submit actions. Paging stays bounded and retains the selected source as before; updates clear selections and clamp pages. Visual cache/fallback remains shared.

checks.title: Stale input and display recovery
checks.steps: Hold a lower tab/row/page control while changing upper state, switching Hero/context, toggling/reconnecting the lower display, backgrounding/resuming and resizing if supported. Add/change a pointer, cancel a gesture, and rapidly alternate controls. Reopen the Hero afterward.
checks.expected: Old releases and duplicate events cannot act. Resize now cancels Hero gestures and source selections. One current deck restores, with no stale hit regions, wrong-Hero action, focus loss or stuck selection.

checks.title: Shared shell and neighboring decks
checks.steps: Recheck Town overview/Army/Services and Previous/Next/Close, Hero Meeting army/artifacts and exact split, Tavern, resource trading, Adventure and Battle. Use upper touch/controller and repeat normal play with the lower display disabled.
checks.expected: Shared window navigation and neighboring decks retain their existing behavior. Upper focus/input and single-display operation remain intact; no crash, duplicate Presentation or stale lower actions.
